texte.Déployeur — j’emploie un système acheté: Deployer — I use a system I bought
texte.Déployeurs : utiliser les systèmes confo: Deployers: use systems in accordance with the provider’s instructions, assign competent overseers, monitor operation, suspend in the event of risk, inform the provider of incidents.
texte.Déployez des modules de formation ciblés: Roll out training modules targeted by role (developer, business, executive).
texte.Déposez la documentation technique, la d: Upload the technical documentation, the EU declaration of conformity and the Annex II instructions received from the manufacturer.
texte.Déposez les livrables de cadrage, les gr: Upload the scoping deliverables, the decision grids and the lessons learned.
texte.Déposez les supports, les procédures et: Upload the materials, procedures and exercise minutes to the knowledge base, organised by skill and not by session.
texte.Déroulez les # étapes de classification: Go through the # classification steps for one case.
texte.Déroulez les cinq étapes de classificati: Go through the five classification steps for each system hosted or operated.
texte.Désignation et lettre de mission du DPO: Designation and engagement letter of the DPO
texte.Désigner et former des superviseurs huma: Designate and train competent human overseers
texte.Désigner un point de contact pour la not: Designate a point of contact for notification to the authorities (ANSSI/CSIRT)
texte.Désigner un point de contact pour les au: Designate a point of contact for the authorities (CERT-FR in France)
texte.Désigner un responsable conformité AI Ac: Designate an internal AI Act compliance lead
texte.Désigner un responsable de la gestion de: Designate a person responsible for ICT risk management at senior management level
texte.Désigner un responsable de la gouvernanc: Designate an AI governance lead with authority and resources
texte.Désignez nommément les personnes chargée: Name the people responsible for oversight, and check that they have the competence, the time AND the authority to override an output of the system.
texte.Détail du cadre applicable à une juridic: Details of the framework applicable in a jurisdiction: texts in force or in draft, competent authority, severity level, points to watch. One profile per country, accessible from the world map or the comparator.
texte.Détection anticipée des défaillances ; r: Early detection of failures; fewer supply shortages.
texte.Détection d'intrusion par ML, réponse au: ML-based intrusion detection, automated incident response, network behaviour analytics (UEBA)
texte.Détection de chute, capteurs de présence: Fall detection, presence sensors in the home: Article # of the GDPR, and certified hosting as soon as the data becomes health data.
texte.Détection de présence et d'atmosphère :: Presence and atmosphere detection: failure is paid for in lives. Effective human oversight (art. #) and an emergency stop independent of the system.
texte.Détection de risques sur chantier par vi: Vision-based risk detection on construction sites
texte.Détermine en quelques minutes le niveau: Determines in a few minutes the risk level and the exact legal obligations — avoids discovering a critical obligation too late in the project.
texte.Détermine la classification d un système: Determines the classification of an AI system (prohibited, high-risk, limited risk, minimal) and its associated obligations, by answering # guided steps — before even recording it in the register.
texte.Détermine si vous restez déployeur ou si: Determines whether you remain a deployer or have become a PROVIDER without knowing it. It is the switch organisations discover the latest, usually after fine-tuning a model they bought.
texte.Détermine, pour chaque traitement du reg: Determines, for each processing activity in the records, whether an impact assessment is required, according to the CNIL’s nine criteria. Two criteria together make a DPIA necessary.
texte.Déterminer l'accès, l'admission ou l'aff: Determining access, admission or assignment; evaluating learning outcomes; assessing the appropriate level of education a person will be able to reach; monitoring and detecting prohibited behaviour during tests. The point covers “all levels”. An institution that does any one of the four is a deployer of a high-risk system.
texte.Déterminez les traitements nécessitant u: Identify the processing activities requiring a DPIA and assess their risks.
texte.Déterminez tôt si un organisme notifié d: Determine early whether a notified body must be involved: its lead time drives your whole timetable.
texte.EFFACEMENT RGPD — supprimer les données: GDPR ERASURE — delete the KYC data, notes, reminders and follow-up, and anonymise the personal contact details of this client’s account? Invoices and contracts are kept (linked by a pseudonymised identifier) under the #-year statutory accounting obligation. The account will be deactivated. This action is irreversible.
texte.EU AI Act — Entrée en vigueur obligation: EU AI Act — Entry into force of high-risk AI obligations
texte.Effacer de ce navigateur les réponses: Clear from this browser the answers
texte.Effacer les choix de politique enregistr: Clear the policy choices saved in this browser?
texte.Effacer les relevés d’adoption enregistr: Clear the adoption readings saved in this browser?
texte.Effet juridique, ou effet significatif s: Legal effect, or similarly significant effect, on the person
texte.Elle agrège ce qui a été saisi ailleurs: It aggregates what was entered elsewhere and is not filled in here. An incomplete AI register produces a reassuring and false executive view: check the register before presenting the summary.
texte.Elle dit qui est connecté, sous quelle o: It says who is signed in, under which plan, and gives the only two routes that matter: sign out, or sign in. Sentinel had fifty-two tabs and not one spoke of the account — the session existed only in a button in the top bar, between two buttons that looked the same.
texte.Elle décrit un rapport de force, pas un: It describes a balance of power, not a right
texte.Elle engage l’organisation sur des oblig: It commits the organisation to obligations whose cost is counted in months.
texte.Elle est à notifier à l’autorité de surv: It must be notified to the market surveillance authority — allow for the corresponding lead time in your timetable.
texte.Elle ne chiffre PAS le coût de votre mis: It does NOT cost your compliance effort — neither person-days nor notified body fees. These figures are neither in the Regulation nor reliably public, and inventing them would produce a document that looks like a quote without being one: it would be cited in committee. And the amounts displayed are CEILINGS, never forecasts: Article #(#) requires account to be taken of the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement, the operator’s history and its size. The penalty regime itself is set by each Member State.
texte.Elle ne classe pas les douze par gravité: It does not rank the twelve by severity: the order in the document is alphabetical, and NIST refrained from setting a hierarchy. And AI #-# is a PROFILE of the framework, not a second framework: citing it without the framework underneath is citing the profile of nothing.
texte.Elle ne compte jamais une case vide comm: It never counts an empty box as a green box: the number of rows not provided is displayed next to the rate, on purpose. And ticking all ten does not prove compliance — the Article says “at least”, and proportionality is assessed against your actual exposure, your size and the likely severity of incidents.

It never counts an empty box as a green box. The rate displayed always comes with the number of rows not provided, because a rate calculated on three requirements says nothing about the other eighteen — and that is the one shown in committee. “Not applicable” is a reasoned decision that leaves the denominator; “not provided” is an absence of decision, which stays in it.
texte.Elle ne conserve rien : elle interroge l: It keeps nothing: it queries the session each time it opens, because a stored state would be wrong at the very moment you come to consult it. And signing out ends the session on this browser only — the register, the audit and the documents stay attached to the account.
texte.Elle ne contrôle pas que l’adresse saisi: It does not check that the address entered is actually in Île-de-France: outside that area, write before booking. It keeps only ONE session per slot, and the same topic only once per company — the SIRET, not the email address, counts the free session.
texte.Elle ne cote rien à votre place et n’imp: It rates nothing on your behalf and imposes no scale: the standard prescribes none, the one proposed is the firm’s, and it says so. Nor does it consider a risk treated because a plan exists: as long as the measures are not declared implemented, the residual level entered remains a forecast and the module keeps the initial level. Finally, it reproduces no sentence of the standard — numbers and titles only.
texte.Elle ne couvre cependant pas tout —: It does not, however, cover everything —
texte.Elle ne donne pas la date de fin de la p: It does not give the end date of the transition period for # certificates, because it could not verify it: iso.org, iaf.nu and cofrac.fr cannot be reached from this environment, and an unverified date would be cited in committee as if it were verified. Your certification body knows it for your certificate. And the comparison with NIS # is the firm’s reading, not an official correspondence: it guides the file, it does not prove it for you.
texte.Elle ne délivre aucune conformité. Le ca: It delivers no compliance. The NIST framework cannot be certified: no body accredits, no auditor is authorised, no certificate exists. “NIST AI RMF compliant” means nothing — at best, it means “we used it”. Nor does it give an overall score, and that is deliberate.
texte.Elle ne fusionne aucun document et ne pr: It merges no documents and does not claim that one deliverable is worth another. Being # certified does not make you compliant with any legal obligation and does not exempt you from any; conversely, a system perfectly compliant with the AI Act is not worth a certified management system. A budget built on “we will do a single analysis” falls apart at the first inspection.
texte.Elle ne juge pas la QUALITÉ de votre ana: It does not judge the QUALITY of your risk analysis: it measures the completeness of what you declare. And it is not addressed to everyone — objective # is reserved for essential entities on grounds of proportionality. For an important entity, the page says so instead of displaying a zero that would be read as a failure; the analysis nevertheless remains necessary to justify any exclusion from scope, and measure a) of the Directive remains due.
texte.Elle ne montre que ce que le Registre co: It only shows what the register contains
texte.Elle ne notifie rien et ne remplit aucun: It notifies nothing and fills in no form. And it does not apply the postponement to noon of the next working day to credit institutions, central counterparties, trading venue operators or to essential or important entities under NIS #: for them, Article #(#) rules out the postponement, and the clock runs over the weekend.
texte.Elle ne notifie rien à votre place et n’: It notifies nothing on your behalf and starts no countdown. Nor does it say whether your incident is “significant” within the meaning of the Directive: that qualification is made on the facts, and it is what starts the clock. A useful point in meetings: notifying does NOT increase the liability of the notifying entity — the text says so itself, and that closes off the bad advice to keep quiet.
texte.Elle ne produit aucune délibération ni a: It produces no resolution and no attestation, and says nothing about national law on managers’ liability, which varies from one Member State to another. A company training plan, however complete, does not establish the training of the members of the management body: what is expected is named and dated.
texte.Elle ne prononce aucune qualification op: It pronounces no enforceable qualification: the competent national authority does that, on the actual entity. And it says nothing about the TRANSPOSITION law, which is what really binds you — NIS # is a Directive, not a Regulation. Finally, it registers you nowhere: the registration under Article #(#) is made with the authority, and its deadline — # April # — is behind us.

It pronounces no enforceable qualification: the ACPR or the AMF do that, on the actual entity. And it does not confuse size with regime: Article # defines microenterprise and small enterprise, but these definitions do NOT decide the simplified framework, which rests on named categories. A microenterprise that falls into none of the five is subject to the full framework.
texte.Elle ne prédit aucune désignation : les: It predicts no designation: the European Supervisory Authorities designate, through the Joint Committee, on the recommendation of the Oversight Forum. Passing stage # does not amount to designation, and stage # cannot be computed. Nor does it reproduce the list of designated providers: it is published and updated every year, and a copied list ages without warning.
texte.Elle ne prédit pas l’issue de l’étape #: It does not predict the outcome of stage #: that is where the auditor cross-checks the “status” column against what they observe, and Sentinel does not hold that evidence. Nor does it reproduce the text of the controls — the standard is paid for and protected, and an engine guard rejects any field containing anything other than a number and a title.
texte.Elle ne prédit pas l’issue de l’étape #,: It does not predict the outcome of stage #, which is audited on evidence of execution that Sentinel does not hold. Nor does it claim that a statement covering the thirty-eight controls is complete: the standard itself says that Annex A is not exhaustive, and that an organisation may need to design other controls if risk treatment requires it. The “include all” and “exclude all” shortcuts save thirty-eight clicks, not thirty-eight decisions.
texte.Elle ne qualifie pas votre produit à vot: It does not qualify your product on your behalf and guesses no class from a name: you are the one who chooses, and the summary says so. The sector exclusions and the general clause of Article # are a matter for legal analysis carried out on the actual product, not for a box ticked by whoever sells it. Nothing is kept: it is a qualification tool, not a register.
texte.Elle ne remplace ni l’organisme certific: It replaces neither the certification body nor its quote, and says nothing about actual accreditation lead times. It reproduces no sentence of the standard — numbers and titles only — and does not exempt you from buying it.
texte.Elle ne rend JAMAIS un taux de conformit: It NEVER gives a compliance rate. Neither the bill nor the reference framework is in force: the bill has not been passed, ReCyF bears “DOCUMENT DE TRAVAIL” [WORKING DOCUMENT] on every page, and the Conseil d’État decree that is to set the objectives does not exist. What binds you today remains the Directive. The figure given here is a READINESS rate; it enters no consolidated index, and it will change in nature on the day of the decree — through a decision, not an automatic switch.
texte.Elle ne rend pas de note sur dix : les d: It does not give a score out of ten: the ten do not weigh the same and the list is not a marking scale. And the list carries an edition — this one could NOT be cross-checked against the online publication from the build environment, owasp.org being refused there: the page flags it, and it must be reopened before being presented.
texte.Elle ne reproduit AUCUNE phrase de la no: It reproduces NO sentence of the standard: ISO/IEC #:# is protected by copyright, and this page cites its numbers and titles, everything else being written by the firm. Holding the text remains necessary to get certified. Nor does it accept that a clause from # to # be declared “not applicable”: these are requirements, they cannot be excluded. Only Annex A controls can, and only with justification.
texte.Elle ne reproduit aucune exigence de la: It reproduces no requirement of the standard — numbers and titles only, the standard being under copyright. And it does not say the opposite either: the controls cited “touch” the risk, they do not close it.
